svg.title: The rerun of a run that failed
svg.desc: A message names a run of GitHub Actions that failed on main: that of a workflow, or an entry of the alarm, such as a release. Dennis presses Rerun, and the pager reads the run. While it still runs, or once it passed on a retry, the button says so and nothing starts. Otherwise its failed jobs run again, and the message says so. When they fail again, the message shows the failure, and Rerun can run them once more. When they pass, the workflow turns green, or the entry goes, and the last one turns the alarm green.
